title: EMC Gold to Money
description: An EarthMC texture pack that changes all gold textures to green money-like colors
body: This is a texture pack meant for the EarthMC Minecraft server that changes all gold textures to fit a money-like color to fit the servers gold built economy. If more gold textures are added or I left out some, feel free to ask for them to be added. May rework some textures.
